text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and fix them quickly. When tests are well written, developers gain confidence that their changes will not break existing features. Testing also makes it easier to improve the code over time, because a good test suite quickly shows whether something has gone wrong. In short, testing helps teams build reliable software and work with greater confidence.
